description: Event delivered to participants: trigger conditions, delivery channel, content, expected responses, assessment criteria (platform writeup). expectedResponse and assessmentCriteria are optional BY DESIGN in this profile (emergent adjudication).

schemas.description: Delivery channel. Values are False Flag's real episode channels, not the reference platform's media channels (email/phone/radio/SMS/PA) - vocabulary mapping is an open question.

contents.name: trigger
contents.description: Trigger conditions (platform writeup). type enum covers scheduled (time), conditional (event) and facilitator-fired delivery; the condition grammar for event triggers is unpublished, so it is a free-text field here.

contents.name: timing
contents.description: Placement offset, field names verbatim from the exercise-platform reference docs: {phaseRelative, minutes} or {sceneRelative, seconds}. Indices are 0-based.

contents.name: expectedResponse
contents.description: Optional BY DESIGN: False Flag exercises have no scripted expected response; play is adjudicated emergently.

contents.name: assessmentCriteria
contents.description: Optional BY DESIGN: emergent adjudication replaces declared criteria (see AdjudicatedDecision).

contents.name: effects
contents.description: False Flag profile extension: scripted world-metric effects. delta is a string because the source data uses ranges such as '5..8'.

contents.name: variants
contents.description: Multi-role inject variants, shape verbatim from the exercise-platform reference docs.
